title: The Lincoln Highway
author: Amor Towles
summary: In 1954, an eighteen-year-old comes home from a work farm and plans to drive to California with his little brother. Two friends from the farm turn up with other plans, and the trip heads east to New York.
readIf: you like warm, wide-ranging novels with many voices and a strong sense of mid-century America.
skipIf: you want a streamlined plot; it jumps between many narrators and detours often.

pairings.reason: The same author's tighter, more polished novel set within one hotel.
The classic American journey about boys on the run, which this book openly nods to.
A more restless, freewheeling version of the American road story, with much less structure.
